title: Cavelon dev-kit offline bundle manifest
description: manifest.json at the top of cavelon-bundle-<version>.tar.gz (docs/offline-bundle.md). Format 1. A reader ignores members it does not know; a new format number means a change a reader of format 1 cannot follow.

version.description: The kit's release version: the CLI's, the plugin's and the skills'.

repository.description: The repository whose release workflow built and signed the bundle.

commit.description: The commit the release was built from, when the builder was told.

instance_contracts.description: The instance contract versions this release understands, as it compares them with an instance's /api/v1/meta/capabilities (contracts.api_version, contracts.package_versions).

executables.description: The standalone executable for each platform the bundle carries.

mcp.description: The offline MCP entries: they start the cavelon on the PATH, never npx.

entry.description: The entry for agents without a plugin.

files.description: Every file of the bundle but manifest.json itself, sorted by path, relative to the bundle's top folder.

path.description: Relative, with forward slashes, no empty, "." or ".." part.
